opportunities.title: Small Grants – UK
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Applicants must belong to, or provide evidence of support from, an organisation or institution that is willing to receive grant funds. Applications are not accepted from individuals seeking support for personal projects, though the UK office may consider applications from individuals who can provide proof of organisational support.
opportunities.summary: Seed funding for UK‑Japan collaborative projects across arts, culture, humanities, social issues, Japanese language, medicine and health, science, youth and education, and sport.

opportunities.title: Small Grants – Japan
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Applicants must belong to, or provide evidence of support from, an organisation or institution that is willing to receive grant funds. Applications are not accepted from individuals seeking support for personal projects, though the Japan office may allow applications from informal groups that can open a bank account.
opportunities.summary: Seed funding for UK‑Japan collaborative projects across arts, culture, humanities, social issues, Japanese language, medicine and health, science, youth and education, and sport.

opportunities.title: Butterfield Awards in Medicine and Health

amount.raw: up to £10,000 per year, up to £30,000 total

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Applicants should normally have an existing research record; open to researchers, practitioners, managers, carers in health‑related fields who intend to establish UK‑Japan collaborations. Preference is given to early‑career applicants and those not previously involved in UK‑Japan collaboration.
opportunities.summary: Supports exchanges and collaborations between health and medical professionals in Japan and the UK, covering scientific, clinical, social and economic issues in healthcare.
